questions.q: The 'Samudra Manthan' National Offshore Exploration Scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet, has a total outlay of:
questions.explain: Samudra Manthan is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas with an outlay of Rs 84,084 crore up to Financial Year (FY) 2030-31.

questions.q: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026 raised the sanctioned strength of the Supreme Court to:
questions.explain: The Bill, passed by the Lok Sabha on 3 August 2026, raised the strength from 34 to 38 judges including the Chief Justice of India.

questions.q: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 renames the state of Kerala as:
questions.explain: The Bill amends the First Schedule of the Constitution to rename Kerala as Keralam, following a unanimous resolution of the Kerala Assembly.

questions.q: India celebrated which Independence Day on 15 August 2026?
questions.explain: 15 August 2026 was the 80th Independence Day celebration, marking 79 completed years since 1947.

questions.q: Which of the following was one of the two official themes of Independence Day 2026?
questions.explain: The PIB-listed themes were '150 Years of Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.

questions.q: The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign 2026 was conducted during which period?
questions.explain: The campaign ran from 9 to 17 August 2026 and was launched by Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat.

questions.q: How many gallantry awards did the President approve for Independence Day 2026?
questions.explain: President Droupadi Murmu approved 78 gallantry awards, including 9 Kirti Chakras and 19 Shaurya Chakras, plus 89 Mention-in-Despatches.

questions.q: The Union Cabinet approved a permanent bench of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh in:
questions.explain: A permanent bench of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh was approved for Ladakh.

questions.q: Processing of pending Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA) applications was transferred by the Home Ministry to:
questions.explain: The Ministry of Home Affairs transferred processing of pending Citizenship (Amendment) Act applications to District Collectors.

questions.q: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026 extends legal protection against disturbance to:
questions.explain: The amendment extends Section 3 protection from the National Anthem to the National Song, Vande Mataram.

questions.q: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 targets malpractice in exams conducted by:
options: Only Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and SSC
questions.explain: The Bill covers examinations conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), SSC, Railway Recruitment Boards and the National Testing Agency.

questions.q: Who became the Union Education Minister in 2026 after Dharmendra Pradhan resigned?
questions.explain: Pralhad Joshi took over as Education Minister after Dharmendra Pradhan resigned in July 2026 amid protests over exam irregularities.

questions.q: India signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance with the United States (US) to procure which missile system through the Foreign Military Sales (FMS) route?
questions.explain: India will procure Javelin anti-tank guided missiles from the United States (US) through the Foreign Military Sales route; Javelin is a fire-and-forget system.

questions.q: Delhi's Pink Saheli Smart Card is mandatory for:
options: Free bus travel for women and transgender commuters on DTC/cluster buses
Free metro rides for senior citizens
questions.explain: The Pink Saheli Smart Card replaced pink paper tickets for free bus travel for women and transgender commuters in Delhi.

questions.q: eSARAS is an online marketplace for products of:
options: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) exporters
Women Self-Help Groups under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
questions.explain: eSARAS markets products made by women Self-Help Groups under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission.

questions.q: The e-Shram portal, which completed five years on 26 August 2026, registers:
questions.explain: Launched on 26 August 2021, e-Shram is the national database of unorganised workers.

questions.q: A nine-judge Constitution Bench redefined the term 'industry' under which law?
questions.explain: By a 5:4 majority, the bench redefined 'industry' under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, refining the 1978 precedent.

questions.q: The Supreme Court directed the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to frame a Standard Operating Procedure to tackle:
options: Digital arrest scams and mule accounts
questions.explain: The Court asked the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to frame an Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) against digital arrest scams and mule accounts used to launder the proceeds.

questions.q: During Prime Minister (PM) Modi's August 2026 visit, India elevated its ties with Uzbekistan to a:
questions.explain: India and Uzbekistan elevated ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, including long-term uranium supply cooperation.

questions.q: Vishwesh Negi was appointed India's next Ambassador to which country?
questions.explain: Vishwesh Negi (Indian Foreign Service, 2002 batch) was appointed Ambassador to Iran.

questions.q: The 10th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Industry Ministers' Meeting under India's 2026 chairship was hosted in:
questions.explain: India hosted the 10th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Industry Ministers' Meeting at Jaipur.

questions.q: Which country became the 26th member of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA)?
questions.explain: Saudi Arabia joined the India-led International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) as its 26th member; the alliance covers seven big cats.

questions.q: The United States removed which country from its State Sponsors of Terrorism list in 2026?
questions.explain: Syria was removed from the United States (US) list, where it had been placed in 1979.

questions.q: Which country's parliament formally abolished the death penalty in 2026?
questions.explain: Lebanon's parliament abolished capital punishment, replacing it with life imprisonment with hard labour.

questions.q: Nauru officially changed its name in 2026 to:
questions.explain: Nauru adopted its indigenous name, Republic of Naoero.

questions.q: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)+ approved a production increase of how much for September 2026?
questions.explain: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)+ approved an increase of 188,000 barrels per day for September 2026.

questions.q: The indigenous TARA glide weapon system was test-released from which aircraft?
questions.explain: TARA, India's first indigenous glide weapon, was released from a Jaguar aircraft off the Odisha coast.

questions.q: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) completed 10 years in August 2026. It was launched by National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in which year?
questions.explain: The Unified Payments Interface was launched by the National Payments Corporation of India in 2016.

questions.q: Favara, the payment system integrated with Unified Payments Interface (UPI) for cross-border transfers, belongs to which country?
questions.explain: Maldives' Favara system was integrated with Unified Payments Interface (UPI) by National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) International Payments Limited for real-time transfers.

questions.q: India's non-fossil-fuel installed electricity capacity crossed which milestone by end-July 2026?
questions.explain: Non-fossil capacity crossed 300 GW, over 54% of India's total installed electricity capacity.

questions.q: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government for 2025-26 of:
questions.explain: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) transferred a record Rs 2.86 lakh crore as surplus/dividend to the Government for 2025-26.

questions.q: The PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana received a financing package of $890 million from:
questions.explain: The World Bank extended an $890 million financing package for the rooftop solar scheme targeting 1 crore households.

questions.q: QDENGA, which received market authorisation in India in 2026, is the country's first approved vaccine for:
questions.explain: QDENGA is India's first approved dengue vaccine, authorised for ages 4 to 60.

questions.q: India's first indigenous African Swine Fever vaccine was developed by:
options: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal
Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi
questions.explain: The vaccine was developed by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research - National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal.

questions.q: India recorded how many organ transplants in 2025, crossing 20,000 for the first time?
questions.explain: National Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation (NOTTO) data recorded 20,138 organ transplants in 2025, up from 4,990 in 2013.

questions.q: Glaw Lake, designated India's 101st Ramsar site, is located in which state?
questions.explain: Glaw Lake in the Kamlang Tiger Reserve is Arunachal Pradesh's first Ramsar site.

questions.q: As per the 16th Asiatic Lion Population Estimation, India's lion population in 2025 was:
questions.explain: The population rose to 891 lions in 2025, up from 523 in 2015, across about 35,000 sq km of the Gir landscape.

questions.q: Sarnath, inscribed on the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage List in 2026, became India's:
questions.explain: Sarnath, where Buddha delivered his first sermon, is India's 45th United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Under Samudra Manthan, government support for deepwater drilling is capped at:
options: 25% of cost or Rs 300 crore per well
50% of eligible cost or Rs 675 crore per well, whichever is lower
questions.explain: Support covers up to 50% of eligible drilling cost or Rs 675 crore per well, whichever is lower, for 60 deepwater wells.

questions.q: The 'Ugram' 7.62x51 mm assault rifle was developed by Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) together with:
questions.explain: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) developed the Ugram rifle with Dvipa Defence India Pvt Ltd.
